i226-lm.note: The only port with AMT. A host OS that bridges it or changes its MAC kills out-of-band access without touching anything that looks related.

i226-v.note: No AMT. Identical-looking socket next to the one that has it.

appliance.note: A KVM, a PDU or a transfer-switch card: one network port, and management is all it does.

mgmt.note: Its only port, so unlike an MS-01 there is no identical socket next to it to get wrong.
